title: The Otherworld Files

opening.text: Marrow Creek, 1986. The night the lights went out.
The power has been out for an hour. My watch says 11:48.
Callum's jacket is still on the hook. But he is gone.
The basement lights are blinking by themselves. That is not the storm.
Callum always said lights can talk. Let's go down.

tutorial.title: Look around
tutorial.text: Drag the picture to turn around. Look closely: tiny golden sparkles mark things you can tap, and a blue-green sparkle means a puzzle is ready. Real-looking objects can be picked up.

tutorial.title: The timer
tutorial.text: You have 7:00 for the whole game. The clock stops only while Juno and Otto talk, in this tutorial and in the pause menu.

tutorial.title: Signal
tutorial.text: Signal is your score. Finding clues and solving rooms earns it. Wrong answers and hints cost it.

tutorial.title: Sparks
tutorial.text: Wren, your helper on the walkie-talkie, gives you 4 Sparks for the whole game. Each power you use spends one, and they never come back.

tutorial.title: Powers
tutorial.text: Flicker wakes one dead light or machine. Push moves one heavy thing. Veil calms flickering shadows. Tap a power to read it, then tap what to use it on. A power used in the wrong place is wasted.

tutorial.title: Hints
tutorial.text: The walkie-talkie gives 2 hints in each room. Each one costs Signal but never a Spark.
tutorial.action: Tap Hint once. This one is free.

tutorial.title: The Casebook
tutorial.text: Everything you find is saved here: items, notes and File pages.

tutorial.title: Pause
tutorial.text: Pause stops the clock and hides the puzzle. Resume puts you back exactly where you were.

tutorial.title: Ready
tutorial.text: Sparkles are small on purpose. Look around, think, and follow the hum.

tutorialFreeHint: Free hint: look at the note on the corkboard.
skipToast: Wren gave you 4 Sparks. Tap a power icon to read what it does.

idle.text: Try turning around. Drag to look around.
What have we not looked at yet?
Open the Casebook. Maybe something fits.

pages.title: Page 1: Follow the hum
pages.text: The wall in Juno's basement flashed FOLLOW THE HUM. Callum left it for us.

pages.title: Page 2: The staff token
pages.text: A brass token stamped CARETAKER was locked in the arcade. Someone from the station was here that night.

pages.title: Page 3: The Static
pages.text: The Static follows loud sounds, cannot stand steady bright light, cannot cross a line of salt and feeds on live electricity.

pages.title: Page 4: The hum and the time
pages.text: A woman hummed a lullaby into the radio line at 10:44 p.m., three minutes before the lights failed at 10:47.

pages.title: Page 5: The badges
pages.text: Badge 07 entered the gate room at 10:44 p.m. Badge 07 is Ines Corvane, the caretaker. Aldous Finch (03) left at 9:40. Gus Harlow (11) went home at 6:00.

pages.title: Page 6: Why
pages.text: A child's drawing of a girl and a woman. It says: Mama's lullaby. The music box lid has a name scratched in it: Mira.

rooms.name: Basement Alphabet Wall
rooms.objective: Find out what the lights on the wall are saying.

hotspots.name: Corkboard note

card.title: Corkboard note
card.text: "Bulbs talk. Watch the whole thing first, then copy it back."

hotspots.note: Callum's note: Bulbs talk. Watch the whole thing first, then copy it back.

line.text: Callum's writing. He says to watch first.

card.title: Callum's flyer
card.text: A flyer for the Starlight Arcade. Callum drew something on the back. It is saved in your Casebook.

line.text: Starlight Arcade. Callum was there last Friday.

panel.title: The Alphabet Wall
panel.intro: The wall will light some bulbs, one at a time. Watch them. Then tap the same bulbs in the same order. You can watch again as often as you like.

wrong.text: Slow down. Watch the whole sequence before you tap.
Callum's note says to copy it back, in the same order.
Press Watch Again. Say each letter out loud as it lights.

right.text: Follow the hum. Callum left that for me.
A hum? Like a sound, or a machine?
Maybe both. Let's find out.

line.text: Do round one first. You can watch again as often as you like.

rooms.name: Starlight Arcade
rooms.objective: Open the locked cabinet in the arcade.

enter.text: Callum's flyer says the high score night. Something is hidden here.

hotspots.name: Wall poster

line.text: The other half of the key. Eight symbols, two halves.

hotspots.note: Wall poster key: star = S, heart = T, triangle = E, cross = O.

hotspots.name: Scoreboard

line.text: Four symbols. It is too dark to make them out.

hotspots.note: Scoreboard: four symbols, too dark to read.

lineLit.text: Bright and steady now. Star, heart, bolt, diamond.

hotspots.noteLit: Scoreboard, left to right: star, heart, lightning bolt, diamond.

fxLine.text: The scoreboard lit up. Look at it again.

flyerLine.text: Callum drew half a key on the back.

rooms.flyerNote: Flyer back key: lightning bolt = A, diamond = R, moon = M, dot = K.

panel.title: The Locked Cabinet
panel.intro: Turn the four dials to spell the word, then press Open.

wrong.text: Each symbol is exactly one letter. Find all four on a key.
Callum wrote half the key on the back of the flyer. The poster has the rest.
Read the scoreboard left to right. The first symbol is a star, and the star's letter is S.

right.text: S, T, A, R. Starlight Arcade.
A staff token. It says CARETAKER.
Someone from the station was here that night.

line.text: Use both halves of the key. Each symbol on the scoreboard has one letter.

rooms.name: Game-Night Garage
rooms.objective: Find out how the Static can be stopped.

enter.text: My garage. Game night is Friday. Callum always played the warden.
The warden. That sounds like what is out there.

hotspots.name: Warden monster card

line.text: The Gloom Warden. In my game it has four weaknesses.

hotspots.note: Gloom Warden: follows loud sounds; cannot stand steady bright light; cannot cross a line of salt; feeds on electricity from live wires.

hotspots.name: Gear chart poster

line.text: Five gear cards. Each one does something different.

hotspots.note: Gear chart: Echo Drum = loud noise far away. Sun Lantern = steady bright light. Salt Ring = pours a line of salt. Rubber Cutters = cut a live wire safely. Bouncy Ball = only bounces.

fxLine.text: The toolbox scraped aside. The whole warden card is readable now.

cards.name: Echo Drum
cards.text: Makes a loud noise far away.

cards.name: Salt Ring
cards.text: Pours a line on the floor.

panel.title: The Card Table
panel.intro: Put one gear card on each rule, then press Check.

rules.text: Cannot cross a line of salt.
Feeds on electricity from live wires.

wrong.text: Each card counters exactly one rule. Read what each card does.
The chart says what each card does. The warden's card says what it fears.
The lantern gives steady light. Which rule is about light?

right.text: It follows sounds, hates bright light, can't cross salt and feeds on power.
Like the thing in the dark.
That is the Static. Your game is closer to the truth than you know.

line.text: Match what the warden fears with what each card does.

rooms.name: Lakeside Radio Hut
rooms.objective: Find out what was on the radio that night.

enter.text: A radio hut. Callum said to follow the hum.
Four tapes. Maybe one of them hums.

hotspots.name: Radio

card.title: The radio
card.text: A big old radio. The dial is dark and it makes no sound.

hotspots.note: The radio is dead. The old recorder has a crank.

line.text: The radio is dead. The old recorder has a crank.

fxLine.text: The radio dial lit up. Maybe the tape recorder will run faster now.

card.title: Four tapes
card.text: Four cassette tapes, A to D. Use each one on the recorder to hear it. They are saved in your Casebook.

line.text: Four tapes. Let's hear each one.

A.caption: Ten minutes after the storm warning, a car left the station road.

B.caption: Power is out across town. It is ten forty-seven p.m.

C.caption: Storm warning for Marrow Creek, issued at nine thirty p.m.

D.caption: Three minutes before the lights failed, a woman hummed a lullaby into the line.

panel.title: The Timeline Board
panel.intro: Put the tapes in the order they happened, earliest first, then press Check. Some tapes give a time and some only say how long before or after.

wrong.text: Listen to all four tapes. Each one gives a time, or says how long after or before something.
One tape says the lights failed at ten forty-seven. Another says three minutes before that.
Do the sums: ten forty-seven take away three, and nine thirty add ten.

right.text: A woman hummed a lullaby, three minutes before the lights failed.
Callum said to follow the hum. It is her.
The hum starts at the station. Find the lab.

line.text: Listen to every tape and write down its time. Two tapes need a sum.

rooms.name: Hidden Research Lab
rooms.objective: Find out who was in the station that night.

enter.text: I am Wren. This is where they kept me.
Then someone left a paper trail.

hotspots.name: Test room cot
hotspots.note: Test room: Badges open every door.

line.text: Badges open every door. Whoever has one can go anywhere.

hotspots.name: Staff roster board

line.text: Three staff, three badges. A paper trail needs this key.

hotspots.note: Roster: 03 Aldous Finch, Director. 07 Ines Corvane, Caretaker. 11 Gus Harlow, Night Guard.

card.title: Two slips
card.text: Two slips of paper from the drawer. Each one belongs to somebody.

line.text: Slips of paper. Each one belongs to somebody.

card.title: A slip
card.text: A slip of paper from the wastebasket.

card.title: Two slips
card.text: Two slips of paper from the printer tray.

card.title: The hidden slip
card.text: A slip of paper that was stuck behind the heavy cabinet.

fxLine.text: The cabinet moved. Something was stuck behind it.

panel.title: The Corkboard
panel.intro: Tap a slip, then tap the person it belongs to.

wrong.text: Each slip belongs to one person only. Start with the ones that name someone.
The roster says which badge number belongs to which person.
Badge 03 is the Director. Badge 07 is the caretaker. Badge 11 is the guard.

right.text: Badge 07 was in the gate room at 10:44, three minutes before the lights failed.
And the Director left at 9:40.
The gate room is under the quarry. The tunnels lead there.

line.text: Slips with a badge number need the roster. Slips with a name or a job go straight to the person.

rooms.name: Tunnels Under Marrow Creek
rooms.objective: Cross the tunnel floor to the far wall.

enter.text: The floor is a grid of different tiles.
The Static drifts through these tunnels. Stay quiet.

hotspots.name: Wall rhyme

line.text: A rhyme. Eight lines, so eight steps.

hotspots.note: Rhyme: glow-cap, moss, glow-cap, moss, drip, glow-cap, stone, moss.

hotspots.name: Plaque

card.title: Plaque
card.text: "Step only to a touching tile, never diagonally and never onto the same tile twice. Begin at the tunnel mouth and end at the far wall."

hotspots.note: Plaque: touching tiles only, no diagonals, no tile twice. Start at the tunnel mouth, end at the far wall.

line.text: Touching tiles only, no diagonals, no tile twice.

fxLine.text: The glow holds steady. Now you can make out the tiles.

rhyme: Start on the glow-cap's gentle gleam,
then moss to soothe you like a dream.
Glow-cap again, to guide your way,
then moss to keep the Static at bay.
Now one wet drip, where waters run,
then glow-cap, bright as a tiny sun.
Last, a stone as grey as slate,
then moss, and open is the gate.

panel.title: The Tunnel Floor
panel.intro: Start in row 1 and step to a touching tile for each line of the rhyme. Finish in row 5.

wrong.text: Each line of the rhyme names one kind of tile. Take them in order.
You can only step to a touching tile, never the same one twice. Eight lines, eight steps.
Line one is glow-cap. Only one glow-cap sits in the first row, at the far right. Start there.

right.text: We made it across. And look, a drawing.
A girl and a woman. It says: Mama's lullaby.
The hum. A mother's lullaby.
The rift door is just ahead. Be ready.

line.text: Count the lines of the rhyme. Each line is one tile, and tiles must touch.

rooms.name: The Otherworld
rooms.objective: Say what really happened and close the rift.

enter.text: The Otherworld. It is our basement, upside down.
Stay close. The Static is near.

hotspots.name: Music box

line.text: The lullaby. And a name scratched in the lid: Mira.

hotspots.note: Music box: plays the lullaby. The name Mira is scratched in the lid.

hotspots.name: Callum's torn sleeve

card.title: Callum's sleeve
card.text: A torn jacket sleeve. Callum steps out of the ash and speaks.

hotspots.note: Callum: the rift stays open while the hum plays. It only breaks when someone says the whole truth.

line.text: Juno! I stayed to stop it growing. The rift stays open while the hum plays. It only breaks when someone says the whole truth.

panel.title: The Rift
panel.intro: Finish each sentence. You only get 3 tries: every wrong answer lets the Static come closer. Open the Casebook to read the pages again.

sentences.text: The hum that Callum told me to follow is a ___.
The woman was heard humming at ___ p.m.
At that time, badge ___ entered the gate room.
She opened the gate to find her ___.

wrong.text: Each sentence matches one File page. Open the Casebook and read them again.
Page 4 is about the hum and the time. Page 5 is about the badges. Page 6 is about why.
The badge in the gate room at 10:44 was badge 07. The roster says 07 is the caretaker.

right.text: Ines Corvane hummed a lullaby at 10:44 and opened the gate with badge 07. She did it to find her daughter, Mira.

line.text: Page 4 is the hum, page 5 is the badges, page 6 is why.

ending.text: Ines Corvane hummed a lullaby at 10:44 and opened the gate with badge 07. She did it to find her daughter, Mira.
I only wanted to bring Mira home.
The gate takes. It does not give back.
The rift begins to close. The light thins.
Callum, Juno, Otto and Wren step out through the closing gap. Ines stays behind and waves with the music box as the rift shuts.
Back in the basement. Callum hugs Juno. The alphabet wall blinks once: HOME.
Juno Park. There is a second door.

loseStatic.title: The Static Wins.
loseStatic.text: The rift swallowed the last light. The gate stays open.

briefing.title: The Night the Lights Went Out
story: A storm cut the power at 10:47 p.m. and Callum Park, 16, vanished from his family's basement.
His sister Juno and her friend Otto saw the lights blink by themselves. Someone opened a gate to the Otherworld. Help them find out who.

narration.text: The Night the Lights Went Out. A storm cut the power at 10:47 p.m. and Callum Park, 16, vanished from his family's basement. His sister Juno and her friend Otto saw the lights blink by themselves. Someone opened a gate to the Otherworld. Help them find out who. Solve the mystery!

threat: The lights stutter. Something is near.
